title: Backprop claim
description: One line of a stage attempt's backprop-claims.jsonl (goobers.dev/backprop/claim/v1). A claim is the writing agent's statement, attributed by the runner to the writing stage attempt; it is never authorization or graph structure. Runtime additionally strips control and Unicode format characters from the statement, bounds an encoded line to 8 KiB, and keeps at most 32 claims per stage attempt and 256 per run.

kind.description: Claim type: the target owns described work (assignment), the writer consumed the target's output (reliance), or the target helped (credit) or hurt (blame) the outcome.

target.description: The one stage, nested agent, or recorded artifact the claim is about.

statement.description: Untrusted free text explaining the claim; required for assignments, sanitized on write and read.

evidence.description: Journal records supporting the claim; credit and blame claims need at least one to be verified.

confidence.description: The writer's own confidence in the claim; reported, never used to weight credit.

attempt.description: Stage attempt; omitted means the latest attempt recorded before the claim.

artifact.description: Content digest of a recorded artifact.
Content digest of a recorded artifact supporting the claim.

seq.description: Sequence number of an earlier journal event supporting the claim.
